quotes.title: HD 52265
quotes.card: HD 52265, also named Citalá, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet companion in the equatorial constellation of Monoceros.
quotes.introduction: It is dimly visible to the naked eye with an apparent visual magnitude of 6.29.
